description: Order a full reachability report for one site: up to 20 pages, each checked from nine common clients. Returns a report_id and report_url at once; the pages are scanned in the background, about ten seconds each. The finished report gives the likely cause of every refusal with exact fix steps and a reproducing curl command, a prioritised fix list, and three free re-scans within 30 days. Use reach_report_status to read it. For a single quick check use the reach tool instead. Costs $69.00 in USDC on Base, paid via the x402 protocol, or from a credit token — call credits_trial for free credit if you have neither.

credit_token.description: Optional. A credit token from credits_trial or /credits/buy. Supplying it pays for this call from that balance, so no x402 payment or wallet is needed.

urls.description: 1 to 20 public HTTP(S) URLs on one site (at most 3 hostnames)

name: reach_report

eta_seconds.description: Roughly how long until the report is complete
